messages:
mira: quick question — support gave me a request_id (req_9f2b). I need the original HTTP body + the app pod logs around that request. Fastest path?

alex: if you have request_id, start with Logs -> query with \"request_id:req_9f2b\" in the obs console (set time +/- 5m). That shows the proxy and app lines.

sam: console is easiest for quick eyeballing. if you want raw lines from pods use kubectl + stern:
```
stern -n prod 'redwood-.*' --since 10m | rg req_9f2b
```
this streams multi-pod logs and highlights the id.

jong: if the console trace link exists, click the trace and then the \"Associated logs\" tab — that jumps you to the aggregated log lines across services. obs-bot often posts the trace link too.

obs-bot: Trace for trace_id=tr_7c1a: https://obs.redwood.ai/trace/tr_7c1a (Associated logs available) :mag:

mira: thanks — support only sent request_id, no trace_id. Is there a quick mapping from request_id -> trace_id?

alex: usually request_id is attached as a span tag on the ingress span. In console you can search spans with filter \"tags.request_id: req_9f2b\" and it will show the trace id. Or from CLI: 
```
ri traces search --tag request_id=req_9f2b --json | jq -r '.[0].trace_id'
```
If that returns empty, the proxy might not have propagated the header.

sam: alternative: search logs for the request_id at the edge to get the span_id, then open the trace by span id. Example: 
```
# find span line in edge proxy logs
grep -R \"req_9f2b\" /var/log/proxy/*.log | head
# copy span_id and open in console trace search
```

mira: got it. one more — if console collapses the request_id field, any quick jq/grok query to pull JSON fields?

jong: yes, in console logs use the JSON extractor: put this in the query builder: 
```
json.payload.request_id == \"req_9f2b\"
```
or in CLI: 
```
ri logs query --filter 'json.payload.request_id:req_9f2b' --range 15m
```
should return raw event bodies.

mira: perfect — that should do it. I'll try console first, then stern if I need pod-level context. Thanks :thumbsup:

alex: ping me if you need help crafting the grep/jq, happy to jump in.

mira: will do, thanks everyone!
